label: California data breach notification deadline
applies: Disclosure to a California resident whose unencrypted personal information was acquired by an unauthorized person
movesWhen: Only by legislation. It last moved on 1 January 2026 and holds until amended again
note: The duty previously ran on a standard rather than a deadline: notice in the most expedient time possible and without unreasonable delay. That phrasing is gone from subdivision (a). Any incident response plan or checklist drafted against it is describing a rule that no longer applies. The only carve-out this corpus establishes is the law enforcement delay in subdivision (c).
author: Aaron Bollinger
